references.label: Crane center lane
references.description: The lane behind the wrecking ball starts Main Multiball and collects its Jackpot and Super Jackpots.

references.label: Wrecking ball and car targets
references.description: Hits on the suspended ball into the upper car targets add MULTIBALL letters and collect Crane Hurry-Up.

references.label: Lower standup banks
references.description: The two lower three-banks add MULTIBALL letters and light their matching outlane Recycles.

references.label: D-O-G video-mode scoop
references.description: The right-center scoop spells D-O-G and starts the qualified video mode.

references.label: Sewer sinkhole
references.description: The right-center sinkhole starts Adventures and Time Machine and collects several lit awards.

references.label: Toaster Gun standup
references.description: The standup beside D-O-G converts five Toast into one Firework.

references.label: Great Toilet ramp
references.description: The far-left ramp collects toilet spins, Window Shopping, and related Adventure objectives.

references.label: Magic Bus ramp
references.description: The adjacent inner-left ramp collects Bus Rides, Junk, and Magic Bus awards.
